entities.name: Gwalior State
entities.label: Place
entities.summary:
The Gwalior State was a 
state within the Maratha Empire located in Central India. It was ruled by the House of Scindia, a Hindu Maratha dynasty. Following the dissolution of the Confederacy, it became part of the Central India Agency of the Indian Empire under British protection.
